# Copenhagen Office

## About the office

Our headquarter is located in the heart of Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark.

The central location makes the office easy to reach, no matter where you live, through walking, biking, metro, or bus. Our fantastic team is located on the 2nd floor, right next to the well known Kødbyen. Formalize occupies its own floor in a newly renovated office facility, creating an energetic environment. The office offers fridges with cold drinks and coffee machines that provide delicious daily caffeine. Lunch is served in the shared canteen based on the first floor. We also have comfortable sofa areas where you can take a break, play a game of chess, or even work if you prefer a relaxed setting.

Beyond being a great place to get work done, the office also hosts numerous after-hours activities, with colleagues often staying to enjoy time together long after the workday ends. These activities strengthen team spirit and create friendships across teams and nationalities. Furthermore the Copenhagen office has a special relation to the Aarhus office, often joining them in Aarhus for social and sports events.
